verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills plugin that runs inside other agents' CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Devin CLI, Gemini CLI). Its slash commands, those hosts' install commands, and the generic `npx skills add` installer belong to the host platforms or third-party tools, not to Superpowers. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party Superpowers command-line tool, so the applicable axis is unmet.
